title: Masala Chai

steps.x: Put the water, milk, tea bags and chai masala into a saucepan and stir.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, about 4 min. Stay close, because milk boils over fast.

parts.x: Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, about 4 min. Stay close, because milk boils over fast.

steps.x: As soon as it boils, reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 min.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve into 2 mugs. Stir in the sugar and serve right away.

notes: The book scales by mug: 3 parts water to 1 part milk. This is sized for 200 ml mugs, 150 ml water and 50 ml milk per person.
Per person: 1/4 tsp chai masala and 2 tsp sugar.
With CTC tea, simmer closer to 2 min for a stronger, more traditional cup.
Add the sugar after straining, as the book does, so you control sweetness.
